# 靈魂綁定附魔

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1327308441324097681?label=discord&color=blue&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/5UdcDa5xNC) 
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/ly-soulbound-enchantment?label=modrinth&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ly-soulbound-enchantment) 
[![許可證](https://img.shields.io/github/license/lullaby6/data-packs)](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)

***

## 📖 說明

「靈魂綁定」附魔能讓你在死亡時保留物品。

此附魔可從附魔台、戰利品箱或與村民交易獲得。

這個資料包與「doImmediateRespawn」遊戲規則設為 true 時不相容。

***

## ❗ 相容性

- 與 [Graves](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ly-graves) 相容！

***

## ⌨️ 指令

給予：

```mcfunction
/loot give @s loot soulbound_enchantment:soulbound
```

附魔：

```mcfunction
/enchant @s soulbound_enchantment:soulbound
```
